en-US.name: CHAINBRIEF
en-US.subtitle: Crypto news, briefed fast
en-US.description:
CHAINBRIEF is a fast, clean crypto news reader. Breaking headlines, short analysis and exchange listing updates in one calm feed.

• Live flash news: the market-moving headlines of the day, marked when they matter
• Analysis: short, sourced articles that explain what happened and why it matters
• Exchange listings: new spot and futures listings, warnings and delistings across major global exchanges, plus upcoming listings
• Markets: prices and daily moves for the coins people follow
• Save to read later, even offline
• English, 中文 and 한국어 editions
• Light and dark themes

CHAINBRIEF is a news and information app. It does not offer trading, wallets or investment advice, and nothing in the app is a recommendation to buy or sell any asset.
en-US.promo: Breaking crypto headlines, short analysis and exchange listings in one calm feed. English and 中文 editions.

zh-Hans.name: CHAINBRIEF
zh-Hans.subtitle: 加密快讯，一眼读懂
zh-Hans.description:
CHAINBRIEF 是一款简洁、快速的加密货币新闻阅读器。突发快讯、简短分析与交易所上币动态，集中在一个清爽的信息流里。

• 实时快讯：当天影响市场的重要消息，重点新闻醒目标记
• 深度分析：有出处的短篇文章，讲清发生了什么、为何重要
• 交易所上币：主要交易所的现货与合约新上币、风险提示与下架信息，以及即将上线的项目
• 行情：常见币种的价格与日涨跌
• 收藏文章，离线也能阅读
• English、中文、한국어 三个版本
• 浅色与深色主题

CHAINBRIEF 仅提供新闻与资讯，不提供交易、钱包或投资建议，应用内任何内容均不构成买卖任何资产的推荐。
zh-Hans.keywords: 加密货币,比特币,区块链,快讯,新闻,以太坊,上币,行情,稳定币,ETF,Web3,DeFi
zh-Hans.promo: 加密货币突发快讯、简短分析与交易所上币动态，一个清爽的信息流全部看完。

review.notes:
CHAINBRIEF is a free crypto news reader (flash news, articles, exchange listing updates, market prices). No login and no purchases.
All content comes from our own news site (probe2928-crypto.github.io/chainbrief) as JSON feeds; the screens are native, not a website wrapper.
The app offers no trading, wallets, exchange sign-up links or investment advice. Small partner banners for non-exchange crypto information services may appear and open in the in-app browser.
Language switch (EN / 中文 / 한국어) is under the Saved tab → settings.
